title: Appeals and Grievances Resolution Timeframe Schedule
content:
The resolution period of an **Appeals and Grievances** case, the most by which its due date may be extended, the notice periods for an extension and for the resolution, and whether the resolution is also given orally are set per case type as follows.

## Schedule

| Case type | Resolution period (from the filed date) | Unit | Extension of the due date, at most, once (calendar days) | Written notice of an extension within (calendar days after deciding it) | Written resolution notice mailed within (business days after resolution) | Resolution also given orally |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Member Grievance | 90 | Calendar days | 14 | 2 | 3 | No |
| Quality of Care Grievance | 30 | Calendar days | 14 | 2 | 3 | No |
| Standard Appeal | 30 | Calendar days | 14 | 2 | 2 | No |
| Expedited Appeal | 72 | Hours | 14 | 2 | 1 | Yes |
| State Fair Hearing | 90 | Calendar days | 0 (no extension allowed) | 0 (not applicable) | 3 | Yes |
| External Medical Review | 45 | Calendar days | 0 (no extension allowed) | 0 (not applicable) | 3 | Yes |

## Footnotes

- (a) The resolution period is read in the unit shown in its row: an Expedited Appeal is resolved within 72 hours of its filed date, every other case type within the stated number of calendar days.
- (b) The extension figure is a ceiling on the calendar days by which the resolution due date may be moved, and it may be used once. A figure of 0 means that no extension is allowed for that case type.
- (c) The resolution notice period is counted in business days, unlike the other periods in this schedule, which are counted in calendar days or, for the Expedited Appeal resolution period, in hours.

## Hypothetical readings

- A Quality of Care Grievance whose due date is extended by the full ceiling moves by 14 calendar days, and the written notice of that extension is due within 2 calendar days of deciding it.
- A State Fair Hearing is resolved within 90 calendar days of its filed date with no extension available; the written resolution notice is mailed within 3 business days of resolution and the resolution is also given orally.
- A Standard Appeal resolved on a given day has its written resolution notice mailed within 2 business days, with no oral resolution notice.
